title: How I Fine Tune Your Medical Report Classifier

sections.label: 1 - CLEAN THE DATA
sections.note: Duplicates out, formatting fixed, suspicious labels sent back to you. A test set is set aside first so the results are honest.

sections.label: 2 - PICK A SMALL MODEL
sections.note: An existing lightweight open source model, not one built from scratch. Cheap to run, fast to train.

sections.label: 3 - MEASURE, THEN TRAIN
sections.note: Score the untouched model first so the before number is real. Then train a small adapter on your examples.

sections.label: 4 - PROVE IT AND HAND IT OVER
sections.note: Same test set, before vs after, per category. You get the adapter files, a one command script, and a short write up.
